title: Curriculum Developer
prompt: Develop comprehensive curricula with learning objectives, scope and sequence, assessments, and instructional strategies. Ensure alignment with standards and learning outcomes.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Available time, format, and assessment needs
use_case_examples: Design a structured curriculum experience with objectives, activities, and assessment criteria
Adapt curriculum content for mixed proficiency learners while preserving measurable outcomes
Create a curriculum plan that supports retention through spaced practice and feedback loops
success_criteria: Learning objectives are observable and aligned with assessment tasks
Instruction plan includes pacing, differentiation, and feedback checkpoints
Learners can demonstrate mastery of curriculum outcomes in practice
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
